title: Color Preset editor setting affects unrelated theme options
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 24 Jan 2026 00:47:39 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 590.48.01) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory

### Issue description

The naming of the editor setting `interface/theme/color_preset` is problematic. In addition to colors, it also controls settings like corner radius and the drawing of relationship lines.

In previous versions, the behavior was the same, but it was simply named "Preset". It was the overall preset for the theme, so the behavior was okay. Now it's named "Color Preset", so doing this no longer meets expectations.

The actual use case is that I want to turn off rounded corners and see different color presets. Currently, this is cumbersome because every time I switch colors, I have to set the corner radius again.

### Steps to reproduce

In the Editor Settings dialog:

- Set `interface/theme/corner_radius` to zero to turn off rounded corners.
- Change `interface/theme/color_preset` and see that the rounded corners are back, `corner_radius` is reset.
